    12	
    13	# Frontend Design Ultimate
    14	
    15	Create distinctive, production-grade static sites from text requirements alone. No mockups, no Figma — just describe what you want and get bold, memorable designs.
    16	
    17	**Stack**: React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Framer Motion  
    18	**Output**: Vite (static HTML) or Next.js (Vercel-ready)
    19	
    20	## Quick Start
    21	
    22	```
    23	"Build a SaaS landing page for an AI writing tool. Dark theme, 
    24	editorial typography, subtle grain texture. Pages: hero with 
    25	animated demo, features grid, pricing table, FAQ accordion, footer."
    26	```
    27	
    28	---
    29	
    30	## Design Thinking (Do This First)
    31	
    32	Before writing any code, commit to a **BOLD aesthetic direction**:
    33	
    34	### 1. Understand Context
    35	
    36	- **Purpose**: What problem does this interface solve? Who uses it?
    37	- **Audience**: Developer tools? Consumer app? Enterprise? Creative agency?
    38	- **Constraints**: Performance requirements, accessibility needs, brand guidelines?
    39	
    40	### 2. Choose an Extreme Tone
    41	
    42	Pick ONE and commit fully — timid designs fail:
    43	
    44	| Tone                       | Characteristics                                           |
    45	| -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
    46	| **Brutally Minimal**       | Sparse, monochrome, massive typography, raw edges         |
    47	| **Maximalist Chaos**       | Layered, dense, overlapping elements, controlled disorder |
    48	| **Retro-Futuristic**       | Neon accents, geometric shapes, CRT aesthetics            |
    49	| **Organic/Natural**        | Soft curves, earth tones, hand-drawn elements             |
    50	| **Luxury/Refined**         | Subtle animations, premium typography, restrained palette |
    51	| **Editorial/Magazine**     | Strong grid, dramatic headlines, whitespace as feature    |
    52	| **Brutalist/Raw**          | Exposed structure, harsh contrasts, anti-design           |
    53	| **Art Deco/Geometric**     | Gold accents, symmetry, ornate patterns                   |
    54	| **Soft/Pastel**            | Rounded corners, gentle gradients, friendly               |
    55	| **Industrial/Utilitarian** | Functional, monospace, data-dense                         |
    56	
    57	### 3. Define the Unforgettable Element
    58	
    59	What's the ONE thing someone will remember? A hero animation? Typography treatment? Color combination? Unusual layout?
    60	
    61	---
    62	
    63	## Aesthetics Guidelines
    64	
    65	### Typography — NEVER Generic
    66	
    67	**BANNED**: Inter, Roboto, Arial, system fonts, Open Sans
    68	
    69	**DO**: Distinctive, characterful choices that elevate the design.
    70	
    71	| Use Case          | Approach                                                     |
    72	| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
    73	| Display/Headlines | Bold personality — Clash, Cabinet Grotesk, Satoshi, Space Grotesk (sparingly), Playfair Display |
    74	| Body Text         | Refined readability — Instrument Sans, General Sans, Plus Jakarta Sans |
    75	| Monospace/Code    | DM Mono, JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono                       |
    76	| Pairing Strategy  | Contrast weights (thin display + bold body), contrast styles (serif + geometric sans) |
    77	
    78	**Size Progression**: Use 3x+ jumps, not timid 1.5x increments.
    79	
    80	### Color & Theme
    81	
    82	**BANNED**: Purple gradients on white, evenly-distributed 5-color palettes
    83	
    84	**DO**:
    85	
    86	- **Dominant + Sharp Accent**: 70-20-10 rule (primary-secondary-accent)
    87	- **CSS Variables**: `--primary`, `--accent`, `--surface`, `--text`
    88	- **Commit to dark OR light**: Don't hedge with gray middle-grounds
    89	- **High contrast CTAs**: Buttons should pop dramatically
    90	
    91	```css
    92	:root {
    93	  --bg-primary: #0a0a0a;
    94	  --bg-secondary: #141414;
    95	  --text-primary: #fafafa;
    96	  --text-secondary: #a1a1a1;
    97	  --accent: #ff6b35;
    98	  --accent-hover: #ff8555;
    99	}
   100	```
   101	
   102	### Motion & Animation
   103	
   104	**Priority**: One orchestrated page load > scattered micro-interactions
   105	
   106	**High-Impact Moments**:
   107	
   108	- Staggered hero reveals (`animation-delay`)
   109	- Scroll-triggered section entrances
   110	- Hover states that surprise (scale, color shift, shadow depth)
   111	- Smooth page transitions
   112	
   113	**Implementation**:
   114	
   115	- CSS-only for simple animations
   116	- Framer Motion for React (pre-installed via init scripts)
   117	- Keep durations 200-400ms (snappy, not sluggish)
   118	
   119	### Spatial Composition
   120	
   121	**BANNED**: Centered, symmetrical, predictable layouts
   122	
   123	**DO**:
   124	
   125	- Asymmetry with purpose
   126	- Overlapping elements
   127	- Diagonal flow / grid-breaking
   128	- Generous negative space OR controlled density (pick one)
   129	- Off-grid hero sections
   130	
   131	### Backgrounds & Atmosphere
   132	
   133	**BANNED**: Solid white/gray backgrounds
   134	
   135	**DO**:
   136	
   137	- Gradient meshes (subtle, not garish)
   138	- Noise/grain textures (SVG filter or CSS)
   139	- Geometric patterns (dots, lines, shapes)
   140	- Layered transparencies
   141	- Dramatic shadows for depth
   142	- Blur effects for glassmorphism
   143	
   144	```css
   145	/* Subtle grain overlay */
   146	.grain::before {
   147	  content: '';
   148	  position: fixed;
   149	  inset: 0;
   150	  background: url("data:image/svg+xml,...") repeat;
   151	  opacity: 0.03;
   152	  pointer-events: none;
   153	}
   154	```
   155	
   156	---
   157	
   158	## Mobile-First Patterns
   159	
   160	See **[references/mobile-patterns.md](references/mobile-patterns.md)** for detailed CSS.
   161	
   162	### Critical Rules
   163	
   164	| Pattern                 | Desktop           | Mobile Fix                                   |
   165	| ----------------------- | ----------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
   166	| Hero with hidden visual | 2-column grid     | Switch to `display: flex` (not grid)         |
   167	| Large selection lists   | Horizontal scroll | Accordion with category headers              |
   168	| Multi-column forms      | Side-by-side      | Stack vertically                             |
   169	| Status/alert cards      | Inline            | `align-items: center` + `text-align: center` |
   170	| Feature grids           | 3-4 columns       | Single column                                |
   171	
   172	### Breakpoints
   173	
   174	```css
   175	/* Tablet - stack sidebars */
   176	@media (max-width: 1200px) { }
   177	
   178	/* Mobile - full single column */
   179	@media (max-width: 768px) { }
   180	
   181	/* Small mobile - compact spacing */
   182	@media (max-width: 480px) { }
   183	```
   184	
   185	### Font Scaling
   186	
   187	```css
   188	@media (max-width: 768px) {
   189	  .hero-title { font-size: 32px; }      /* from ~48px */
   190	  .section-title { font-size: 24px; }   /* from ~32px */
   191	  .section-subtitle { font-size: 14px; } /* from ~16px */
   192	}
   193	```
   194	
   195	---
   196	
   197	## Build Workflow
   198	
   199	### Option A: Vite (Pure Static) — Recommended (Offline)
   200	
   201	A pre-built Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui template with all dependencies is available at `/app/templates/vite-react`. Use it directly without network access:
   202	
   203	```bash
   204	# 1. Copy the pre-installed template
   205	cp -r /app/templates/vite-react my-site
   206	cd my-site
   207	
   208	# 2. Develop — edit src/App.tsx, add components in src/components/
   209	# All shadcn/ui components (button, badge, card, accordion, dialog,
   210	# navigation-menu, tabs, sheet, separator, avatar, alert) are pre-installed.
   211	# Framer Motion, Lucide icons, and Tailwind CSS are ready to use.
   212	
   213	# 3. Build static files
   214	npm run build
   215	# Output: dist/
   216	
   217	# 4. Bundle to single HTML (optional)
   218	bash /app/skills/scripts/bundle-artifact.sh
   219	# Output: bundle.html
   220	```
   221	
   222	### Option B: Init from Scratch (Requires Internet)
   223	
   224	If internet access is available, you can scaffold from scratch:
   225	
   226	```bash
   227	# Vite
   228	bash /app/skills/scripts/init-vite.sh my-site
   229	
   230	# Next.js
   231	bash /app/skills/scripts/init-nextjs.sh my-site
   232	```
   233	
   234	---
   235	
   236	## Project Structure
   237	
   238	### Vite Static (Pre-installed Template)
   239	
   240	```
   241	my-site/                      # copied from /app/templates/vite-react
   242	├── src/
   243	│   ├── components/
   244	│   │   └── ui/              # Pre-installed shadcn/ui components
   245	│   ├── lib/
   246	│   │   └── utils.ts         # cn() helper for className merging
   247	│   ├── styles/              # Global CSS
   248	│   ├── config/
   249	│   │   └── site.ts          # Editable content config
   250	│   ├── App.tsx
   251	│   └── main.tsx
   252	├── index.html
   253	├── components.json           # shadcn/ui config — required for adding components
   254	├── tailwind.config.ts
   255	├── vite.config.ts            # Path aliases (@/) configured
   256	├── tsconfig.json
   257	└── package.json
   258	```
   259	
   260	**`components.json`** is the shadcn/ui configuration file. It tells the `npx shadcn@latest add` CLI where to place components, which aliases to use, and the Tailwind CSS config path. It is pre-configured with:
   261	- Style: `default`
   262	- TSX: enabled, RSC: disabled (Vite, not Next.js)
   263	- Aliases: `@/components`, `@/components/ui`, `@/lib`
   264	
   265	### Next.js
   266	
   267	```
   268	my-site/
   269	├── app/
   270	│   ├── layout.tsx
   271	│   ├── page.tsx
   272	│   └── privacy/page.tsx
   273	├── components/
   274	├── lib/
   275	├── config/
   276	│   └── site.ts
   277	└── tailwind.config.ts
   278	```
   279	
   280	---
   281	
   282	## Site Config Pattern
   283	
   284	Keep all editable content in one file:
   285

   323	
   324	## Pre-Implementation Checklist
   325	
   326	Run this before finalizing any design:
   327	
   328	### Design Quality
   329	
   330	- [ ] Typography is distinctive (no Inter/Roboto/Arial)
   331	- [ ] Color palette has clear dominant + accent (not evenly distributed)
   332	- [ ] Background has atmosphere (not solid white/gray)
   333	- [ ] At least one memorable/unforgettable element
   334	- [ ] Animations are orchestrated (not scattered)
   335	
   336	### Mobile Responsiveness
   337	
   338	- [ ] Hero centers on mobile (no empty grid space)
   339	- [ ] All grids collapse to single column
   340	- [ ] Forms stack vertically
   341	- [ ] Large lists use accordion (not horizontal scroll)
   342	- [ ] Font sizes scale down appropriately
   343	
   344	### Form Consistency
   345	
   346	- [ ] Input, select, textarea all styled consistently
   347	- [ ] Radio/checkbox visible (check transparent-border styles)
   348	- [ ] Dropdown options have readable backgrounds
   349	- [ ] Labels use CSS variables (not hardcoded colors)
   350	
   351	### Accessibility
   352	
   353	- [ ] Color contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI)
   354	- [ ] Focus states visible
   355	- [ ] Semantic HTML (nav, main, section, article)
   356	- [ ] Alt text for images
   357	- [ ] Keyboard navigation works

   361	## shadcn/ui Components
   362	
   363	10 common components pre-installed (button, badge, card, accordion, dialog, navigation-menu, tabs, sheet, separator, avatar, alert). Add more with `npx shadcn@latest add [name]` or install all with `npx shadcn@latest add --all`.
   364	
   365	See **[references/shadcn-components.md](references/shadcn-components.md)** for full component reference.
   366	
   367	Most used for landing pages:
   368	
   369	- `Button`, `Badge` — CTAs and labels
   370	- `Card` — Feature cards, pricing tiers
   371	- `Accordion` — FAQ sections
   372	- `Dialog` — Modals, video players
   373	- `NavigationMenu` — Header nav

steps.message:
The ShiftWise 5-page marketing website has been successfully built and output to `/app/output/`. Here's a summary of what was delivered:

## Output Structure

```
/app/output/
├── index.html          # Home page
├── features.html       # Features page
├── pricing.html        # Pricing page
├── about.html          # About page
├── contact.html        # Contact page
├── favicon.svg
└── assets/             # JS & CSS bundles
```

## Pages & Sections

| Page | Sections |
|------|----------|
| **Home** | Header, Hero, Features, How It Works, Testimonials, Stats, Pricing Teaser, CTA, Footer |
| **Features** | Header, Hero, Core Features, Scheduling, Team Communication, Labor Compliance, Integrations, CTA, Footer |
| **Pricing** | Header, Hero with billing toggle, Pricing Cards, Comparison Table, FAQ accordion, CTA, Footer |
| **About** | Header, Hero, Mission, Team, Stats, CTA, Footer |
| **Contact** | Header, Hero, Contact Form with validation, Office Locations, Footer |

## Key Interactions Implemented

- **Mobile nav toggle** — Hamburger menu opens a slide-in drawer on mobile
- **Testimonial carousel** — Previous/next navigation with dot indicators on Home
- **Pricing toggle** — Monthly/annual billing switch with 20% savings on Pricing page
- **FAQ accordion** — Native `<details>` elements for expand/collapse on Pricing
- **Contact form validation** — Client-side validation with success confirmation
- **Stats animation** — Fade-in on scroll for the stats banner

## Design Choices

- **Typography**: Space Grotesk (display/headings) + Plus Jakarta Sans (body)
- **Color palette**: Deep navy (`#0a1628`) as primary, warm coral (`#ff6b4a`) as accent, cream background
- **Style**: Professional, modern, bold SaaS aesthetic with hospitality warmth
- **Fully responsive** with mobile-first patterns

All pages are directly openable in a browser with relative paths for inter-page links.
